nodes.title: START HERE · three clicks
widgets_values:
1. Choose one performance video below (first 4 seconds by default).
2. Open AnyAngle Studio. Click Read upstream image, then Reconstruct 3D; orbit to a new camera, Preview guide, and Apply to node.
3. Queue. Qwen makes the new-angle still, then H3 animates the ORIGINAL video and speech. The saved MP4 keeps the source audio.
A single photo cannot reveal unseen sides perfectly. Check the guide and Qwen preview before relying on a large camera rotation.

nodes.title: FINAL · New camera with original audio
4 · Render original performance at new angle
widgets_values: crossview. <Picture 1> defines the selected camera position and framing. <Video 1> defines the exact same performer's identity, face, clothes, gestures, expression, and speech timing. Recreate the performance from the new angle without changing the person or dialogue. Keep the full head in frame and lips faithful to the original speech.

nodes.title: 3 · Match photo to the selected camera

extra.zura_notes: Choose one source video; open AnyAngle Studio to reconstruct and rotate its reference still, then Apply to node and Queue. H3 uses the original performance and speech; the exported MP4 carries the original audio. The selected frame is a camera target, not a guarantee of pixel-exact identity or pose. First 96 frames (4 seconds) by default at 24 fps.
